NetImgui Library v1.12.1

1. Integrate the client code (Client_Code) into your own application's project 
2. Connect your application to the provided Server Application (Server_Exe/NetImguiServer.exe)
3. (Optional) Use the sample (Sample_exe\SameBasic.exe) to demo the functionalities of a client application with NetImgui integrated

For integration details, please consult this project's website at: 
https://github.com/sammyfreg/netImgui
